# Divyanshu Singh

> Software engineer and entrepreneur working across cloud, AI and materials science. MS in Computer Science at Texas A&M University (BS in CS, minor in Mathematics). Founder of Vihayas and PharmIndr. Open to research collaborations, engineering roles and startup conversations.

Every page is served as static HTML, so no JavaScript is needed to read it.

## Projects

- [Golden Gate](/goldengate): Golden Gate (laptop app) sends redacted summaries of the coding projects you pick (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) to Golden Gate Bridge (your own server), where an assistant reads them over MCP
- [Golden Gate MCP tools](/goldengate/mcp): The nine read-only MCP tools Golden Gate Bridge exposes (recent_activity, list_projects, get_project_context, search_work, get_session, list_commits, list_pull_requests, list_artifacts, list_issues), with parameters and real sample responses
- [Golden Gate use cases](/goldengate/use-cases): Weekly reviews, resuming a project, finding open pull requests, searching past sessions and drafting write-ups from an assistant that reads your Golden Gate Bridge server
- [Golden Gate security](/goldengate/security): What is never sent, token scopes, the opt-in model summarizer, OAuth, prompt injection and residual risks
- [Forge](/forge): Personal OpenCode V2 desktop fork with review-first plans, edit approvals, built-in browser testing, local memory and Git controls
- [Forge docs](/forge/docs): Setup, edit modes, plan review, browser testing, context and compaction, MCP connections, persistent terminals, memory and Git
- [Harbinger](/harbinger): ML-predicted processing times plus Multi-Level Feedback Queue scheduling to cut message latency; C++20 gRPC broker
- [Harbinger experiments](/harbinger/experiments), [benchmarks](/harbinger/benchmarks), [comparison](/harbinger/comparison)
